description: Header file defining the InspectableNativeWindow class for managing Windows Runtime native windows in ANGLE's D3D11 renderer on WinRT. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and external dependencies related to Windows UI and DirectX interop.

classes.name: InspectableNativeWindow
classes.description: Abstract class for managing Windows Runtime native windows, supporting swap chain creation, resizing, and client rect management.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Pure virtual method to initialize the native window with a platform-specific window handle and property set.

methods.name: createSwapChain
methods.description: Pure virtual method to create a Direct3D swap chain with specified parameters.

methods.name: getClientRect
methods.description: Retrieves the current client rectangle of the window.

methods.name: setNewClientSize
methods.description: Updates the client rectangle based on a new window size, applying scaling if necessary.

methods.name: scaleSwapChain
methods.description: Pure virtual method to scale the swap chain according to window size and client rect.

methods.name: clientRect
methods.description: Calculates the client rectangle based on a given size.
